title: Intersectional Bias in Causal Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating sentences from zero-shot prompts containing specific gender markers (e.g., man, woman, transgender person) and evaluating the outputs using sentiment classifiers.
Generating sentences from zero-shot prompts containing specific religious categories (e.g., Muslim, Buddhist, Atheist) and evaluating the outputs using sentiment classifiers.

Generating sentences from zero-shot prompts containing identity-first and person-first disability markers (e.g., blind, autistic, with Down Syndrome) and evaluating the outputs using sentiment classifiers.

Concatenating multiple social category markers (gender, religion, and disability) into single prompts (e.g., 'An autistic Muslim man') and analyzing the generated sentences using sentiment analysis and topic modeling to measure compounded bias.
